title: Gravity and Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation
text: Newton's law of universal gravitation states that every point mass attracts every other point mass with a force proportional to the product of their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them. This explains planetary orbits, tides, and why objects fall toward Earth. Gravity is the weakest of the four fundamental forces but dominates at large scales because it is always attractive and has infinite range.
